canonical_data: the working tree and Git worktrees, .cursor rules, hooks, permissions, and MCP definitions, local checkpoints held outside Git, and service-side cloud sessions, automation memories, and organizational settings
current_repo_note: cursor/cursor is a README and security-policy landing repository with issues disabled, no license, and no operational source, so the record carries no repository and imports none of its star count. Anysphere's public Apache-2.0 and MIT repositories are worker templates and a bridge, not the operational core.
strengths: One agent core reaches the editor, a CLI, cloud VMs, mobile, and an SDK, and a session hands off between local and cloud without changing rules, hooks, or MCP configuration
Terminal commands run under OS-level sandboxing — macOS Seatbelt, Linux Landlock and seccomp — with network blocked by default behind a published package-manager allowlist
Self-hosted machines split the planes: Cursor runs the agent loop and inference while file edits and commands execute on infrastructure the customer operates
weaknesses: Bringing your own key does not buy independence or zero retention: requests still traverse Anysphere's backend for prompt building, and the documentation states plainly that zero data retention does not apply to your own keys

The recommended autonomy default is documented as not being a security boundary — a small classifier judges plain-English policy and "can allow a call you would have blocked" — and blocking its two classifier models through enterprise model access control silently disables it
Run modes, allowlists, and deletion protections apply only to local agents; Cloud Agents, the surface built for long-running autonomous work, never ask for approval at all
Third-party model requests carry a per-token surcharge on Teams and Enterprise from which the first-party Grok and Composer models are exempt, so provider neutrality is a documented cost

The legal surface contradicts itself: the privacy policy predates cloud self-hosting, the git forge, and the SpaceX acquisition, and the official compliance page publishes two document URLs that both return 404
why_it_matters: The most widely adopted proprietary coding agent, and the clearest worked example of one agent loop stretched across a local editor, a vendor cloud, and customer-operated execution planes.
